title: Madness And Other Ideals
notes: | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Effects that activate when creatures defend are ignored". Fix: H: bc_OnDefend first block: exit for every defender, not only the opposing side. vs bugged: mixed (also cancels your own on-defend effects). USER DECISION: reverses the earlier 'one-sided by design' (CROSS) reading; the global version also cancels the holder's own side's effects User 2026-10-26: global, as the text reads (no prior design ruling by the user). Fix = extend the trait's existing side test to the bearer's side too; no other changes (e.g. Life And Other Illusions: no extra handling of defenders' when-attacked effects). 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Madness And Other Ideals on your creature; Defend with a creature that has an on-defend trait: it should not activate (and enemies' on-defend effects too).

release_notes.intended: Effects that activate when creatures defend are ignored.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only the effects of the side opposing the holder were ignored.
release_notes.fix: Now on-defend effects are ignored for both sides, whichever side holds the trait.
